title: Code and derived results for: Which t-norm should a clinical fuzzy graph reason with? An audited population graph of depressive symptoms and their correlates
description: Analysis pipeline and derived results (relation matrices, edge lists, null-model, bootstrap and t-norm inference results, clinical review form) for a fuzzy relation graph of nine PHQ-9 symptoms and 15 correlates built from NHANES 2007–2018. NHANES source files are public and are downloaded by download_nhanes.py; checksums of the files used are in raw/MANIFEST.md5.
